script_basis.cadence: 1.5-3s normally; earned 4s bases only; front-load the first 60 seconds

doctrine.authoring_mode: fresh; current shots.json not read or reused
doctrine.chain_rule: standalone by default; only a visible, story-needed progressive reveal may use a base plus at most two material deltas
doctrine.human_staging: one seeded named figure for a human beat by default; crowd only when the visible mass is the story point
doctrine.palette_rule: each shot commits to a 2-3-colour beat palette; cool/desaturated passages are deliberate low-point tools
doctrine.catalog_rule: cast, pose, expression, interaction, and costume are closed-world; unresolved needs block authoring

partitions.title: Boom, boast, and the first crack
partitions.vo_end: Terry Johnson was out the door.
palette_passages: muted teal / beige / tobacco for the early-PC boom
terracotta / kraft tan / charcoal only on the brick reveal
slate blue / paper white / charcoal for the 1984 collapse

partitions.title: Doctor Fix It and the number that was not there
partitions.vo_start: By 1985 the company was in real trouble
partitions.vo_end: put his hands on, and tick off a list.
partitions.peak: the locked audit box yields a forged count sheet
palette_passages: steel blue / charcoal / muted gold for Wiles's control
fluorescent green / grey / off-white for the quota and audit pressure
cold blue-grey / paper white / semantic red only for the discovered shortfall

partitions.title: The brick operation
partitions.vo_start: So the managers put their heads together
partitions.peak: the full-pallet brick reveal at the mid-video re-arm
palette_passages: clay red / corrugated tan / soot black for the brick purchase and packing
navy / steel grey / kraft tan for the shipping-and-return loop
desaturated blue-grey / paper pink / charcoal for the Christmas layoff

partitions.title: Discovery, reversal, and the HR punchline
partitions.peak: the final HR counterfactual: the fraud survived every formal control but not its fired workers
palette_passages: cold blue-grey / paper white / black for the restatement and bankruptcy
courtroom brown / ink black / semantic red for the verdict and reversal
winter blue / payroll pink / charcoal for the final HR aftermath

chain_plan.parent_composition: one fixed 1983 home-computer shop shelf with the same foreground PC-box display
material_progression: the PC-box display is fully stocked
most boxes have left, exposing the shelf's empty backing
chain_plan.story_load: The buying frenzy is a visible depletion, not a generic shopper cut.
chain_plan.guard: A new shopper, price-label edit, or reframing is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one MiniScribe production-and-revenue display with the same factory silhouette and counter
material_progression: the annual-revenue counter reads $125 million
the same counter rises to the claimed $600 million peak
chain_plan.story_load: The boom's scale must persist into the later doubt.
chain_plan.guard: A new company, chart type, decorative crack, or expression tweak is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one fixed foreground drive-carton and near-pallet composition
material_progression: the drive carton is closed
one whole carton is opened and visibly contains a red clay brick
the full near pallet face is opened, exposing repeated bricks
chain_plan.story_load: The title's substitution becomes staged material proof.
chain_plan.guard: New figures, reframing, label-only edits, or decorative carton detail are hard cuts.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one MiniScribe loading-dock bay with the same IBM outbound-rack positions
material_progression: outbound racks fill the bay
those same rack positions are entirely cleared
chain_plan.story_load: The cut order visibly empties the operation before the separate layoff and founder consequences.
chain_plan.guard: Worker removal, firing reaction, a new dock, or reframing is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one Wiles target-board composition with the same quota gauge and team-position markers
material_progression: the sales target is at its baseline
the gauge ratchets higher
the same gauge ratchets higher again
chain_plan.story_load: The no-win quarterly escalation is legible before the fraud response.
chain_plan.guard: A figure entrance, bonus/firing reaction, or changed boardroom is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one managers' quarterly-count form on the same count table
material_progression: the required inventory-count field is blank
the whole field is filled with an invented count
chain_plan.story_load: The first paper falsification is a consequential document-state change, not a pen detail.
chain_plan.guard: Pen/clip movement, a new manager, or tiny handwriting-only change is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one accountants' locked count-box and document well
material_progression: the readable box holds the real count sheet
the whole sheet is visibly replaced by a forged one
chain_plan.story_load: The substitution converts the discovered gap into a clean audit.
chain_plan.guard: A clip, wrench, tab, expression, or illegible tiny writing is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one false-inventory ledger column held in the same accounting composition
material_progression: the column has its first fictitious inventory entry
the false column rises another quarter
the same false column rises again
chain_plan.story_load: The paper lie visibly compounds when the clean audit raises the next target.
chain_plan.guard: A new document, accounting setting, or label-only change is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one warehouse packing bench with the same brick pile, carton row, and pallet position
material_progression: loose matched bricks sit beside open drive cartons
the whole carton row has become sealed drive cartons
the sealed-carton row has accumulated into a full pallet tower
chain_plan.story_load: The scheme crosses from purchased material into scaled inventory.
chain_plan.guard: Family/worker entrance, serial-label-only edit, shrink-wrap-only edit, or a new warehouse zone is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one fixed foreground shrink-wrapped pallet face
material_progression: the pallet is wrapped with closed cartons
one whole front carton is opened to a brick
the entire front pallet face is opened, exposing a repeated brick field
chain_plan.story_load: The re-arm proves physical fraud at full operational scale.
chain_plan.guard: A person entrance, local trim, serial-label-only state, or shipping-location change is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one fixed Colorado-Singapore-return route plan with one pallet token and the same route
material_progression: the pallet token is at Colorado dispatch
the same token reaches Singapore
the same token returns to MiniScribe inventory
chain_plan.story_load: The same units must read as a sale in one quarter and inventory in the next.
chain_plan.guard: A second pallet, new map, new route, or customer entrance is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one warehouse audit-count composition with foreground sampled carton and fixed surrounding rack field
material_progression: one selected carton is the bounded test sample
the surrounding rack field resolves as accepted inventory
chain_plan.story_load: The sample-to-whole-warehouse blind spot is visible without a stamp-only delta.
chain_plan.guard: A tick/stamp-only edit, auditor entrance, or new warehouse framing is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one held inventory-rack composition with brick cartons and a bounded scrap section
material_progression: brick cartons dominate with a small scrap section
scrap-filled cartons integrate across the rack
the scrap field visibly dwarfs the brick stock
chain_plan.story_load: The fraud escalates beyond its brick icon into the larger junk-padding problem.
chain_plan.guard: Loose debris addition, exact measured ratio, or a new warehouse zone is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one new-management accounting-table composition with a 1986-88 book run and central loss counter
material_progression: reported books carry the $14 million loss
the whole book run changes to restated entries
the same loss counter deepens to $40 million
chain_plan.story_load: The discovery matters as an accumulating correction, not an isolated number.
chain_plan.guard: Rifenburgh entrance, a new office, or label-only red accent is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one court-clerk case-file composition with the central disposition sheet filling the frame
material_progression: the jury disposition awards $550 million
the whole disposition becomes an overturned judgment
the same case file resolves to the $128 million settlement
chain_plan.story_load: The expectation of a verdict is reversed into the actual recovery.
chain_plan.guard: A stamp-only landing, judge entrance, or new courtroom framing is a hard cut.

chain_plan.parent_composition: one Wiles case dossier with one full-page claim/rebuttal panel in the same folder
material_progression: the dossier carries Wiles's ignorance defense
the whole panel becomes subordinates' rebuttal testimony
the whole panel becomes the pre-exposure share-sale record
chain_plan.story_load: The cumulative case against his denial builds in one readable evidentiary object.
chain_plan.guard: A single added sticky note, prison entrance, or new case setting is a hard cut.
